title: Cloud Server Load Stability Anomaly
scenario: A 'Stability Anomaly' is defined as any server reporting CPU load > 85% for four or more consecutive reporting cycles, ignoring timestamp gaps. Retrieve the server_id, cycle_id, and cpu_load for all cycles participating in such an anomaly, ordered by cycle_id.
tableSchema: server_logs (server_id INT, cycle_id INT, cpu_load NUMERIC)
hint: Use PARTITION BY server_id with the difference-of-row-numbers technique to isolate streaks for each specific server.
correctQuery: WITH AnomalyIslands AS (SELECT server_id, cycle_id, cpu_load, (cycle_id - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY server_id ORDER BY cycle_id)) as island_id FROM server_logs WHERE cpu_load > 85) SELECT server_id, cycle_id, cpu_load FROM AnomalyIslands WHERE (server_id, island_id) IN (SELECT server_id, island_id FROM AnomalyIslands GROUP BY server_id, island_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 4) ORDER BY server_id, cycle_id;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE server_logs (server_id INT, cycle_id INT, cpu_load NUMERIC);
